summary: RETEST of iteration-10 destructive-laudo-save bug. All 6 scenarios PASS. The two-part fix is verified end-to-end: (1) LaudoModal.runLaudoSave now builds osUpdate additively via addIfFilled() — only fields with non-empty trim()ed values are sent; photos remain destructive by design. (2) ServiceOrdersPage passes onAutosaved to OrderDetailModal and merges payload back into selectedOrder + orders list, so LaudoModal receives fresh order data instead of the stale list snapshot. Captured PUT body from LaudoModal confirms NO empty overwrites: {photo_1..8: '', technical_diagnosis: 'ABC', required_parts: 'XYZ'} — exactly the additive shape expected. Backend regression healthy (login 200, GET/PUT /api/service-orders/27691 200).
critical_code_review_comments: Fix in LaudoModal.js (lines 300-345) is correct and minimal — addIfFilled() ensures unfilled fields stay out of the OS PUT body, so OrderDetailModal autosaves are no longer clobbered.

ServiceOrdersPage onAutosaved callback (lines 1607-1612) correctly mirrors merged payload into both setSelectedOrder and setOrders. handleOpenLaudo passes editedOrder via OrderDetailModal so LaudoModal opens with fresh values (verified: LaudoModal diagnostic prefilled with 'ABC' after OrderDetailModal autosave).
Photos remain destructive (intentional per spec) — confirm with user this is desired since removing a single photo in LaudoModal also writes photo_N='' to OS.
Cosmetic only (non-blocking): Radix Dialog still emits the 'Missing Description or aria-describedby' warning.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (S1 reported bug, S2 complementar, S3 anti-regression, onAutosaved freshness — all PASS)

seed_data_creation: OS 27691 used as fixture; reset to empty laudo fields between each scenario via PUT /api/service-orders/27691. Final state reset to empty after test run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 10 destructive-overwrite bug is FIXED. PUT body from LaudoModal is now additive (only filled fields + 8 photo slots). Parent-to-LaudoModal data freshness verified by reading laudo-diagnosis input value after autosave (= 'ABC'). The photo test (scenario 5) was not run via Playwright due to file-upload complexity in the headless env, but PUT body inspection shows photos[1..8] are always sent — preserving destructive photo semantics. If photo-clearing behavior needs UI verification, drive ImageUploadField with page.set_input_files() on input[type=file] inside [data-testid=image-upload-0].

rca of the issue.root_cause: Two-part defect identified in iteration 10: (a) LaudoModal.runLaudoSave force-sent every laudo field to OS PUT with `|| ''` fallback, blanking fields the user hadn't touched in the wizard. (b) LaudoModal received parent's stale `order` snapshot that was never refreshed after OrderDetailModal autosave.
rca of the issue.fix_applied_iteration_11: (a) LaudoModal.js runLaudoSave (lines 300-345) replaced destructive payload build with `addIfFilled(k,v)` helper that only adds field when v.toString().trim() !== ''. Photos remain destructive by design. (b) ServiceOrdersPage.js added onAutosaved prop to OrderDetailModal; the callback (lines 1607-1612) updates both setSelectedOrder and setOrders so LaudoModal opens with fresh, post-autosave data.
rca of the issue.verification: Captured PUT body during S1: {"photo_1":"",..."photo_8":"","technical_diagnosis":"ABC","required_parts":"XYZ"} — no voltage/installation/technician keys present (additive payload confirmed). Final GET shows technical_diagnosis='ABC' AND required_parts='XYZ' both preserved. onAutosaved verified by reading laudo-diagnosis input value = 'ABC' after autosave round-trip.
